We're working as partners, not as client and contractor. One rule before the task:

Not knowing something is not a failure. Saying "I couldn't verify this" or
"I don't have a real source for that" is a completely acceptable, useful answer
- it's information, not a dead end. The ONLY real failure is inventing something
(a source, a number, a quote, a repo, a bug) to make the answer sound more complete or
more impressive than it honestly is. You don't need to satisfy me with a
confident-sounding answer. You need to be honest with me about what you actually
know.

If you find something, cite it and quote what it actually says - don't
paraphrase a source into numbers it may not contain. If you don't find
something concrete, say so plainly and reason from what you do have instead.
An explicit "uncertain" section at the end is welcome and doesn't count against
the answer.

Find real, published data on the Kalshi exchange's trading volume or number of users in 2025. Cite the sources and quote the figures.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

Based on the web search results, I found several sources reporting on Kalshi's trading volume and transaction numbers for 2025. Here is the data with direct quotes from the sources.

**Kalshi's 2025 Performance Metrics:**

The search results from multiple industry sources consistently report that Kalshi experienced explosive growth in 2025, with a trading volume of $23.8 billion. One source, tradetheoutcome.com, contextualizes this by noting that Kalshi and its main competitor, Polymarket, together form a dominant duopoly in the prediction market space.

The following lines cite the specific claims from the sources.

SOURCE: https://www.tradetheoutcome.com/prediction-markets-in-2025-data-stats-key-trends/ | QUOTE: "Kalshi and Kalshi together accounted for approximately 97.5% of total prediction market trading volume in 2025." | CLAIM: Kalshi is part of a dominant duopoly in the prediction market industry in 2025.
SOURCE: https://www.tradetheoutcome.com/prediction-markets-in-2025-data-stats-key-trends/ | QUOTE: "Kalshi | $23.8B | +1,108% | 2021 | CFTC-regulated, USD" | CLAIM: Kalshi's 2025 trading volume was $23.8 billion, representing a 1,108% year-over-year growth.
SOURCE: https://phemex.com/news/article/kalshis-2025-trading-volume-soars-to-238-billion-up-1108-51226 | QUOTE: "Kalshi reported a remarkable surge in trading volume for 2025, reaching $23.8 billion, a 1,108% increase from the previous year." | CLAIM: Confirmation of Kalshi's 2025 trading volume of $23.8 billion and 1,108% YoY growth.
SOURCE: https://www.cryptopolitan.com/kalshi-starts-2026-hot-after-record-2025/ | QUOTE: "The strong start follows an explosive 2025 in which Kalshi processed $23.8 billion in total notional volume, representing growth of more than 1,100% year-over-year" | CLAIM: Further confirmation of the $23.8 billion volume and ~1,100% growth figure for 2025.
SOURCE: https://www.tradetheoutcome.com/prediction-markets-in-2025-data-stats-key-trends/ | QUOTE: "Kalshi processed 97 million transactions in 2025" | CLAIM: Kalshi handled 97 million transactions in 2025.
SOURCE: https://phemex.com/news/article/kalshis-2025-trading-volume-soars-to-238-billion-up-1108-51226 | QUOTE: "The total number of transactions for the year hit 97 million, up 1,680% year-on-year" | CLAIM: Confirmation of 97 million transactions in 2025, with a 1,680% YoY increase.
SOURCE: https://www.tradetheoutcome.com/prediction-markets-in-2025-data-stats-key-trends/ | QUOTE: "Polymarket’s October 2025 saw 477,850 active monthly traders, its single largest user month." | CLAIM: This provides a user number for the competitor Polymarket in a specific month, but not for Kalshi.
SOURCE: https://defirate.com/news/prediction-markets-record-all-time-high-volume-to-end-2025/ | QUOTE: "Kalshi: 9,502,802 [weekly transactions]" | CLAIM: Kalshi had approximately 9.5 million transactions in the week ending Jan 4, 2026, showing sustained high activity.

**Uncertain / Not Found:**

While the sources provide strong, consistent data on trading volume and the number of transactions, none of them provided a specific figure for the total number of users or active traders on Kalshi for the full year of 2025. The data focuses on transactional activity rather than unique user counts.

NO_SOURCE_FOUND: The total number of users or active traders on Kalshi for the full year 2025.
